actions.action: Trace edits through theme-specific token dependencies
actions.mechanism: Resolve reverse dependencies per brand and theme, stopping at explicit overrides and reporting cycles rather than guessing values.
actions.implementation: Build a dependency graph; stage base edits and list changed resolved tokens with alias paths. Mark cyclic paths unresolved.
actions.check: Test a multi-level alias and a cycle; verify propagated values and termination. Confirm an overriding brand value remains unchanged.
actions.risk: A single global graph could misrepresent brand-specific resolution.

actions.mechanism: Check rendered pairs by usage context, not token name, because one token can serve multiple roles.
actions.implementation: Index pairs by component, state, brand, and theme. Recalculate affected pairs against configured contrast requirements; flag failures and unevaluable compositions.
actions.check: Use one token as text and background in separate pairs. Verify both affected uses appear with independently calculated results.
actions.risk: Color checks alone do not establish complete accessibility.

actions.action: Keep brand differences explicit and traceable
actions.mechanism: Attach provenance to resolved values so intentional overrides remain distinguishable from inherited values throughout editing.
actions.implementation: Show each value’s source, override rationale, and alias chain. Require an explicit brand-scoped operation to change or remove an override.
actions.check: Edit the shared base and verify override values and provenance persist. Explicitly removing an override must reveal the inherited source.
actions.risk: Missing rationales can leave intentional differences difficult to interpret.

actions.action: Compare current and proposed values without color
actions.mechanism: Use labeled numeric differences and textual status alongside paired previews, making downstream changes understandable without swatch discrimination.
actions.implementation: Provide a searchable comparison table with token paths, brand/theme, current/proposed values, pair contrast ratios, and written change or review labels.
actions.check: Hide swatches and verify designers can identify changed values, affected pairs, unchanged overrides, and unresolved cases from text alone.
actions.risk: An ungrouped 180-token table could obscure consequential changes.

actions.action: Gate publishing on a versioned pair-review report
actions.mechanism: Bind review decisions to exact proposed values so subsequent edits cannot reuse stale approvals.
actions.implementation: Before publishing, list affected failing or unevaluable pairs and baseline failures separately. Require correction or an explicit, recorded policy-permitted exception; invalidate decisions when inputs change.
actions.check: Approve a proposal, modify a relevant background, and attempt publishing. Confirm the changed pair requires renewed review.
actions.risk: Permissive exceptions can normalize illegible combinations.

actions.action: Offer constrained repairs instead of broad replacement
actions.mechanism: Search for nearby color adjustments satisfying affected pair requirements while treating brand overrides as locked constraints.
actions.implementation: Offer opt-in patches to the base or an explicit semantic token. Show each candidate’s full downstream diff; report when no feasible candidate exists.
actions.check: Create conflicting text/background requirements. Verify infeasibility is reported rather than silently unlocking overrides or accepting a failing candidate.
actions.risk: Numerically valid repairs may still undermine intended visual hierarchy.

actions.action: Publish and restore palettes as atomic versions
actions.mechanism: Keep aliases, overrides, and review evidence together so partial updates cannot produce unreviewed foreground/background combinations.
actions.implementation: Stage the full palette snapshot, validate its review report, and atomically activate that version. Retain the prior snapshot for explicit rollback.
actions.check: Interrupt publishing midway and verify consumers retain one complete version. Roll back and confirm alias resolutions and brand overrides match the prior snapshot.
actions.risk: Consumers with independent caches need coordinated version switching.
